title: Fix Nakshatra Loading Error - Backend Canister Initialization

requirements.text: Investigate and fix the backend canister initialization issue causing 'Unable to Load Nakshatras' error. Ensure the main.mo actor initializes properly and responds to frontend queries without timing out or showing 'service temporarily unavailable' errors.

quotes: The service is temporarily unavailable. The backend canister may be stopped or initializing.

acceptanceCriteria: Backend canister starts successfully without initialization errors
Frontend can fetch Nakshatra data immediately after deployment
No 'service temporarily unavailable' errors appear when loading the homepage or Nakshatra grid

requirements.text: Add proper error handling and retry logic in useQueries.ts to gracefully handle canister initialization delays. Display user-friendly loading states while the backend initializes instead of showing error messages.

quotes: The service is temporarily unavailable. The backend canister may be stopped or initializing. Please try again in a moment.

acceptanceCriteria: Frontend shows a loading spinner or initialization message during canister startup
Queries automatically retry after initialization delays without user intervention
Error messages only appear for genuine failures, not initialization delays

requirements.text: Verify that the default Nakshatras (Ashwini and Bharani) are properly initialized in main.mo during canister deployment and can be retrieved immediately after startup.
acceptanceCriteria: Default Nakshatras are consistently present after fresh deployment
getNakshatras() query returns at least 2 default entries immediately
No stable memory corruption or state initialization issues

constraints: Do not change the single-actor architecture in main.mo
Preserve existing Nakshatra data structure and API interfaces
Maintain compatibility with current frontend query hooks
nonGoals: Adding new Nakshatra features or data fields
